g.text: P1-304 DRUM-TOP VIBRATORY SIFTER: DRAWING SET
Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-304 Drum-top vibratory sifter (built in house) · rev B
Product contact: 2B sheet, #4 polish Ra ≤ 0.8 µm [32 µin]; welds ground flush; passivate ASTM A967
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: Drum-top vibratory sifter P1-304, built in house, 1 off, rev B
Ø480 body on 3 rubber isolators over a 55 gal drum, 12 mesh deck + grate magnet, 2.0 kN vibrator, 16 kg/min capacity vs 3.6 kg/min duty, lid on 4 draw latches, tool-free screen change
check-screen the finished blend from the blender P1-301 into the 55 gal drum: 66.7 kg in ≈ 19 min
316L Ø480 x 14 ga shell, top flange Ø540, screen ledge, 2 magnet bars, all on 3 isolators
12 x 12 mesh 316, 1.53 mm opening, 52 % open, clamped between 2 rings; spare deck
grate 12 x 12 in, rare earth, rests on the bars below the deck
OLI MVE 200/36 class, 1-ph 115 V, set to 78 %, 0.6 mm p-p at 3600 rpm
fn 11.2 Hz, 3.6 % transmitted to the drum; flex band seals the 4 mm gap
drum rim 1,054 AFF; inlet 4 in TC top 1235 AFF under the valve at 1,261; dust 3 in TC to P1-310
isolator in sight (early-break aux), KM-306 on E-stop, bond strap across the isolators, valve interlocked
isolators on R315 outside the rim, seat Ø680, latches on the shell, vibrator axis z 150, pads gap + 2
P1-304 DRUM-TOP VIBRATORY SIFTER: DRAWING SET
BASE WELDMENT (FIXED, ON THE DRUM RIM)
ELECTRICAL: WIRE LIST, CABLES, PLC LOGIC
INSPECTION AND TEST PLAN, DESIGN CALCULATIONS
1. Units mm [in]. Third-angle projection. Tolerances in the title block unless noted. Weld symbols AWS A2.4; welding to AWS D18.1 / ASME BPE MJ.
2. Product-contact parts 316L / 316, Ra ≤ 0.8 µm, welds ground flush, passivated ASTM A967. Seals FDA 21 CFR 177.2600.
3. Cut files (DXF) in dxf/ in mm and inch; 3D: cad/ (STEP per part, P1-304-ASM.step/.glb); generator: design.py, model.py, sh_*.py.
4. Bought parts marked 'confirm' must be checked against the supplier drawing before the matching made part is cut (vibrator feet, latch holes).
5. Release for build: drawings checked, ITP P1-304-900 attached to the traveler, materials certified.
